layers.theme-field: A Form Theme or Form Style field (or, for a site, the site's theme) sets it. set_by names the field. A design may change it to what that field can hold.
layers.derived: The package computes it from another value (set_by). Change that value, never this one.
layers.slds-fixed: The Salesforce Lightning Design System fixes it. No form or site setting reaches it: a design must not change it.
layers.package-fixed: Flow Tool Kit draws it at this value. No setting reaches it: a design must not change it.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one brand color a Form Theme sets (brandColor__c, --ftk-color-primary). FTK maps it onto every SLDS hook: focus borders and rings, checked boxes and toggles, selected radios, brand buttons, selected separated buttons and the neutral button text. 4.65:1 on white. Swap this one value per client; everything else follows.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover shade of brand: the package computes color-mix(brand 85%, black). Hover on brand buttons and selected separated buttons.

tokens.name: brand-active
tokens.usage: Pressed shade of brand: color-mix(brand 80%, black). Pressed brand buttons.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Brand at 12% on white (--slds-s-menu-item-color-background-active). Highlighted option in an open picklist dropdown.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Brand at 10% on white. Fill of a selected Survey Button option.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Brand at 5% on the card surface. Fill of a checked Attestation card.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and check marks drawn on a brand fill (--ftk-color-on-primary). 4.65:1 on brand.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Typed values, selected picklist values and option labels. SLDS body text.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Field labels and positioned-toggle questions (SLDS neutral-base-30). Also the text color of a read-only field. Form Theme labelColor__c overrides it.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, the picklist chevron and the Attestation mark's unchecked ring. 4.67:1 on white.

tokens.name: help
tokens.usage: Help text shown Below Label or Below Field (flow-form-help-below-*). Source value: only 3.07:1 on white, below the 4.5:1 text minimum. Flagged, kept as the package draws it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input, textarea, picklist trigger, checkbox and radio borders, and neutral separated buttons (SLDS border-base-4). SLDS's own value: 1.66:1 on white, under the 3:1 control-border guide. Flagged, kept.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Attestation card border, Survey Button borders and the dropdown edge (SLDS border-base-1).

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: Unchecked toggle track (SLDS neutral-base-60). 2.22:1 on white, SLDS's own value. Flagged, kept.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Input, textarea and picklist fill, dropdown panel, radio and checkbox fill. The ground fields sit on.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Attestation card fill, read-only input fill, dropdown option hover, neutral separated button hover (SLDS neutral-base-95).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error border, inset error ring, error message text and the required asterisk (SLDS error-base-40). 4.65:1 on white. --ftk-color-danger overrides it.

tokens.name: error-strong
tokens.usage: Border of an Attestation card that failed required validation.

tokens.name: error-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of an Attestation card that failed required validation (error-strong at 5%).

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Help bubble tooltip surface (SLDS popover tooltip). White text on it is 13.56:1.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Classic and Card header titles and subtitles (SLDS neutral-base-30). Form Theme headingFontColor__c and headingSubtitleFontColor__c override it.

tokens.name: heading-outlined
tokens.usage: Title on Border title, as the package's sectionFrame fallback draws it. 10.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: heading-muted
tokens.usage: Stacked header pretitle and footer (SLDS neutral-base-40). 6.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: accordion-ink
tokens.usage: Accordion section heading text when the theme sets no accordionFontColor__c.

tokens.name: frame-border
tokens.usage: Box, Shadow, Card and Title on Border frame edge when the theme sets no borderColor__c.

tokens.name: brand-whisper
tokens.usage: Stacked header tag fill: brand at 6%. The tag border is brand.

tokens.name: heading-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Start of the header gradient for the default brand: the package darkens the heading background to 25% (darkenHex). The gradient runs 135deg from this at 10% to the heading background at 80%; recompute it for any other background.

tokens.name: divider-rule
tokens.usage: Divider rules when the theme sets no borderColor__c (--lwc-colorBorder fallback in formSectionDivider). 1.69:1 on white, the package's own value.

tokens.name: divider-subtitle-text
tokens.usage: Divider subtitles (slds-text-color_weak). 5.08:1 on white. headingSubtitleFontColor__c overrides it.

families.sans: "DM Sans", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: field-label

styles.name: field-value

styles.name: field-message
styles.usage: Error messages under a field, in error.

styles.name: field-help

styles.usage: Help text shown Below Label or Below Field (0.65rem) in help. Small by design in the package.

styles.name: field-counter
styles.usage: Text area character counter, drawn at 50% opacity under the box's right edge.

styles.name: toggle-state
styles.usage: On and off messages beside a positioned toggle (0.625rem).

styles.name: label-body-small
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-body_small.

styles.name: label-body-regular
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-body_regular.

styles.name: label-title-bold
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-title_bold.

styles.name: label-heading-small
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-heading_small.

styles.name: label-heading-medium
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-heading_medium.

styles.name: label-heading-large
styles.usage: labelSize = slds-text-heading_large.

styles.name: header-title
styles.usage: Classic, Classic Spread and Card titles (slds-text-heading_medium), regular weight as the package renders it.

styles.name: header-subtitle
styles.usage: Classic subtitle, drawn ABOVE the title (slds-text-body_small).

styles.name: outlined-title
styles.usage: Title on Border with no subtitle (1.5rem). With a subtitle it drops to 20px.

styles.name: outlined-subtitle

styles.usage: Title on Border subtitle, under the border, in placeholder.

styles.name: stacked-eyebrow
styles.usage: Stacked header eyebrow row (icon plus subtitle), uppercase.

styles.name: stacked-pretitle
styles.usage: Stacked header pretitle (kicker) in heading-muted.

styles.name: stacked-title
styles.usage: Stacked header title: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem), so 32px to 44px.

styles.name: stacked-body
styles.usage: Stacked header body (lead) in heading, up to 40rem wide.

styles.name: stacked-tag
styles.usage: Stacked header tags.

styles.name: stacked-footer
styles.usage: Stacked header footer, always last, in heading-muted.

styles.name: accordion-heading
styles.usage: Accordion section heading.

styles.name: divider-label
styles.usage: Every divider label. Case is as authored: type it in capitals for the caps look.

styles.name: divider-subtitle
styles.sample: Who should we contact about this application?
styles.usage: Divider subtitle, in divider-subtitle-text. Centered under centered styles, indented to the label under left-aligned ones.

tokens.name: space-xxx-small
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control (--ftk-label-gap, 0.125rem).

tokens.name: space-xx-small
tokens.usage: Label top padding; gap above an Attestation error message.

tokens.name: space-x-small
tokens.usage: Gap between separated buttons and between Survey Buttons; error message offset; textarea vertical padding; checkbox to inline label.

tokens.name: space-small
tokens.usage: Input and textarea inline padding (start); Attestation card padding (slds-box_small); dropdown option inline padding; gap inside a Survey Button.

tokens.name: space-medium
tokens.usage: Input inline padding (end); separated button inline padding; gap between the Attestation mark and its text; gap beside a positioned toggle.

tokens.name: space-large
tokens.usage: Gap between a positioned-toggle question and its switch.

tokens.name: section-inset
tokens.usage: Header text inset (0.8rem): a section's title and its first field share this left edge.

tokens.name: radius-small

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Inputs, text areas, picklist triggers, the dropdown, separated buttons and the Attestation card (0.25rem). --ftk-radius-medium overrides it.

tokens.name: radius-survey
tokens.usage: Survey Button option cards (0.625rem).

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Box, Shadow, Card and Title on Border frames, and the top corners of a Classic header, when the theme sets no borderRadius__c.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle track and knob, radio circles, the Attestation mark.

sizing.note: Control geometry from SLDS 1 and the FTK control scale (1 by default).
